description: Starts a ready search for `leads` leads. SPENDS CREDITS: first call quote_search, show the price to the user, and only after their explicit yes call this with confirm_credits = the quote's credits_high. stop_at_target (default true) stops at the number of leads. Returns at once (maybe queued); then poll get_search every 30-60 s. Needs a plan or credits on the balance. [REST: POST /api/tasks/{id}/run]

confirm_credits.description: The price in credits the matching quote returned, shown to the user and confirmed by them.

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.

version.description: The spec version from get_search (optional: protects against an edit made meanwhile in the web).

name: run_search
title: Start a search (spends credits)
